profile.description: 2026 Gold Rush Bull Riding Challenge prospect. Event is September 12, 2026 at the Elko County Fairgrounds. Family-focused rodeo event with mutton busting, mini bull riding, bull riding, and women's breakaway. Organizer: Benavides Bucking Bulls LLC. Public organizer email: bbbulls804@gmail.com. Adventure Zone outreach is being made through the event contact form for a possible pay-for-play or prepaid inflatable carnival.
